## Kindle Custom Screensaver v0.4.0

This release adds JPEG images, visible Scriptlet status messages, and improved handling of images that cannot be displayed.

### Changes

* Supports PNG and JPEG images with case-insensitive `.png`, `.jpg`, and `.jpeg` extensions
* Displays large, centered status messages with black text on a white background for two seconds when enabling or disabling
* Shows instructions to add images when the screensavers folder has no supported files, and reports enable or disable failures
* Skips images that fail to render and advances rotation only after a successful draw; if all images fail, stops the daemon and attempts to restore stock screensavers
* Handles image filenames containing commas correctly
* Fixes KPM uninstall handling: stops the screensaver before upgrades or removal, removes the runtime and installed Scriptlet on uninstall, and preserves screensaver images

### Installation and updates

Available through KPM or the `custom-screensaver-0.4.0-kindlehf.zip` release package.

Place PNG or JPEG images in `/screensavers/`, then run the **Custom Screensaver** Scriptlet from the Kindle library.

For ZIP updates, disable the custom screensaver before replacing the runtime files. See the README for full installation and update instructions.
